prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in League City, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1063; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were and what happened?

A: I was driving home on the main road in League City, heading north. It was late afternoon and the traffic had just started to thicken near the intersection. A car coming the other way drifted into my lane while turning, and we ended up in a head-on collision. It wasn't a high-speed hit, but it was enough to jolt me.

Q: Were you going fast at the time?

A: No, I'd say maybe twenty-five miles an hour. I had just started to slow down for the light.

Q: Did the airbags deploy in your vehicle?

A: No, they didn't. I was wearing my seatbelt, and I remember my head snapped forward and then back against the headrest.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same evening. They checked my neck and gave me a muscle relaxer and told me I had a neck strain. I've been going to physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you experiencing any symptoms right now?

A: Yes, I have stiffness in the back of my neck, and I get a dull headache when I've been sitting at a desk for a while. Turning my head to the left is the hardest part.

Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this collision?

A: Not that I'm aware of. I had a little soreness after long workdays, but nothing I had to see a doctor about.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want to be sure the other driver's insurance is contacted about the medical bills. I'm still working, but I've missed a few days because of the pain.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
